title: Musk and Mike Griffin go to Russia for rocket engines

tellings.quote: so he and Mike Griffin go to Russia and they actually find the the the rocket engines

plain: In the early 2000s, the entrepreneur Elon Musk and an aerospace engineer named Mike Griffin are said to have travelled together to Russia, where they "actually find the rocket engines" Musk was looking for. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as part of the early story of Musk's push into building rockets.
